signature: SUBROUTINE ZHPEV( JOBZ, UPLO, N, AP, W, Z, LDZ, WORK, RWORK,

params.name: jobz
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: Compute eigenvalues only;
-   `= 'V'`: Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference:
On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the Hermitian matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2*n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

On exit, `AP` is overwritten by values generated during the reduction to tridiagonal form. If `UPLO = 'U'`, the diagonal and first superdiagonal of the tridiagonal matrix T overwrite the corresponding elements of A, and if `UPLO = 'L'`, the diagonal and first subdiagonal of T overwrite the corresponding elements of A.

params.name: w
params.reference: If `INFO = 0`, the eigenvalues in ascending order.

params.name: Z
params.reference: If `JOBZ = 'V'`, then if `INFO = 0`, Z contains the orthonormal eigenvectors of the matrix A, with the i-th column of Z holding the eigenvector associated with `W(i)`. If `JOBZ = 'N'`, then Z is not referenced.

params.name: ldz
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Z. $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge 1$, and if `JOBZ = 'V'`, $\mathrm{LDZ} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = i`, the algorithm failed to converge; i off-diagonal elements of an intermediate tridiagonal form did not converge to zero.
